# DeprecatedIniOptions

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> 

Group: [Compatibility](/rules/#compatibility) · PhpStorm name: `DeprecatedIniOptionsInspection`

Reading, changing or restoring an ini directive that the targeted PHP version
has deprecated or removed is either a no-op or a future breakage. Point out
such directives, naming the version and the replacement when there is one.

## Example

Target PHP 5.6:

```php{2,3,4,5}
<?php
$enc = ini_get('mbstring.http_output');
ini_set("SAFE_MODE", '0');
ini_alter('mbstring.script_encoding', 'UTF-8');
\ini_restore("always_populate_raw_post_data");
ini_set('asp_tags', '1');
ini_set('track_errors', '1');
ini_set('memory_limit', '64M');
$key = 'safe_mode';
ini_get($key);
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Ini directive &#39;mbstring.http_output&#39; is deprecated since PHP 5.6.0; use default_charset.</li>
<li>line 3: Ini directive &#39;safe_mode&#39; no longer exists since PHP 5.4.0.</li>
<li>line 4: Ini directive &#39;mbstring.script_encoding&#39; no longer exists since PHP 5.4.0; use zend.script_encoding.</li>
<li>line 5: Ini directive &#39;always_populate_raw_post_data&#39; is deprecated since PHP 5.6.0.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "DeprecatedIniOptions": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore DeprecatedIniOptions

/**
 * @noinspection DeprecatedIniOptionsInspection
 */
```
